_: Låsesmeden in English: Locksmith (crack the colour code). «Knapp» is a peg; the lock answers with pins: filled = right place, ring = right colour in the wrong place.
Fire knapper, seks farger, ingen like. T: Four pegs, six colours, no repeats. Ten guesses.
Fire knapper, seks farger, og samme farg: Four pegs, six colours, and a colour can come more than once. Ten guesses.
Fem knapper, åtte farger, like farger ti: Five pegs, eight colours, repeats allowed. Twelve guesses.
{s} på riktig plass, {h} riktig farge på: {s} in the right place, {h} right colour in the wrong place
Each colour only once on easy.
You've used the hint this round.
Denne koden passer med alt låsen har sag: This code fits everything the lock has said so far.
A good first guess – tap Check.
Knekk fargekoden! Låsen har en hemmelig: Crack the colour code! The lock has a secret row of pegs. After every guess it tells you how close you are.
Trykk på knappene nederst for å fylle ra: Tap the pegs at the bottom to fill the row, then tap Check. Every peg has its own colour and its own shape.
En fylt prikk betyr riktig knapp på rikt: A filled pin means a right peg in the right place. A ring means a right peg in the wrong place. The pins don't say which pegs they mean.
Bruk svarene til å snevre inn. Får du al: Use the answers to narrow it down. Fill every pin before you run out of guesses and you've cracked the lock.
Mot mobilen lager mobilen koden. To spil: Against the phone, the phone makes the code. Two players each make a code for the other – whoever needs fewer guesses wins.
På lett er alle knappene i koden forskje: On easy, every peg in the code is different. On medium and hard, the same peg can come more than once.
Bytt ut én eller to knapper om gangen, s: Change one or two pegs at a time, so you can see what made the difference.
Hintet fyller raden med en kode som pass: The hint fills the row with a code that fits everything the lock has said so far.
Med tastatur: tallene 1–8 legger en knap: With a keyboard: the numbers 1–8 lay a peg, the arrow keys choose a place, Backspace takes it out and Enter checks.
The pins say how close you are.
Hvordan vil du spille?: How do you want to play?
Lag en hemmelig kode – gi mobilen til: Make a secret code – pass the phone to
Knekk koden – gi mobilen til: Crack the code – pass the phone to
Velg {n} knapper. {navn} skal prøve å kn: Choose {n} pegs. {navn} will try to crack the code.

{n} forsøk. Nå er det {navn} sin tur til.one: {n} guess. Now it's {navn}'s turn to crack.
{n} forsøk. Nå er det {navn} sin tur til.other: {n} guesses. Now it's {navn}'s turn to crack.

Første knekte kode på {niva} – nå har du: Your first code cracked on {niva} – now you've got a record to beat.
Ingen fare – en ny kode venter, og hvert: No harm done – a new code is waiting, and every guess teaches you something.
Like mange forsøk – dere er like gode lå: The same number of guesses – you're equally good locksmiths.
Fewest guesses to crack the code.
Klarer du å knekke en kode på færre fors: Can you crack a code in fewer guesses?
